defects_corrected.description: The clean-v3 production VAL evaluator built component records from the Phase-12 geometry table carrying only a bbox. evaluate_roi_coverage falls back to BBOX-INTERSECTION coverage when component['mask'] is absent, silently contradicting the frozen native-PIXEL coverage definition.
defects_corrected.correction: Reconstruct native-space 8-connected components from the real VAL mask (foreground = mask > 0, connectivity = 8) and attach the FULL native boolean mask before evaluate_roi_coverage.

defects_corrected.description: Membership was tested as sample_id in a hard-Tiny sample set, and the metric was emitted as a ratio.
defects_corrected.correction: Component-level identity (sample_id, native_component_id); INTEGER COUNT of the 15 hard-Tiny components whose covered90 is True.

defects_corrected.description: The global-empty cohort was evaluated only inside a 'no GT components' branch. Global-empty means the frozen UNet++ GLOBAL prediction was empty; those images still contain GT target components, so the branch was never taken correctly.
defects_corrected.correction: INTEGER COUNT of the 5 frozen image IDs for which ANY GT component has covered90 True, evaluated over all component rows of those images.

defects_corrected.description: Computed the fraction of multi-component cases where ALL components were covered.
defects_corrected.correction: COMPONENT-LEVEL mean of covered90 over all component rows belonging to multi-component images.

frozen_definitions_preserved.coverage_fraction: native GT component pixels inside the union of proposal supports / total native GT component pixels
frozen_definitions_preserved.mean_roi_area_fraction: mean over 103 VAL images of union proposal area / native image area
frozen_definitions_preserved.multi_component_recall90: mean(covered90) over component rows of multi-component images
frozen_definitions_preserved.mean_proposals_per_image: mean emitted proposals over 103 VAL images
frozen_definitions_preserved.reference: frozen historical executing semantics, scripts/training/train_phase13b_localizer.py lines 83 and 86

banned_implementations_explicitly_reject: global-empty restricted to a GT-empty branch

runner_sha_transition.note: This amendment physically declares both runner SHAs. The runner verifies that post_repair_runner_sha equals its own executing SHA, so a runner edited after R2B was frozen cannot inherit the transition.

additional_implementation_corrections.scope_extension: YES — exceeds VAL_EVALUATION_IMPLEMENTATION_ONLY; non-scientific execution fix required to make the authorized same-ID resume runnable

additional_implementation_corrections.description: load_training_checkpoint(..., map_location=device) relocates the stored loader generator state onto CUDA. torch.Generator.set_state requires a CPU uint8 (Byte) tensor, so the first resume attempt aborted with TypeError: RNG state must be a torch.ByteTensor before epoch 29 began. No history row, checkpoint or audit was written by that attempt; all pre-stop evidence re-verified byte-identical afterwards.
additional_implementation_corrections.correction: Move the stored generator state to CPU and pin dtype=torch.uint8 before set_state.
additional_implementation_corrections.discovered_by: first same-ID resume attempt (task ix0ui1), aborted pre-epoch-29
additional_implementation_corrections.evidence_integrity_after_abort: history.csv / latest.pt / best.pt / config / training-start audit all unchanged

disclosure.historical_helper_observation: The frozen historical helper gt_components(mask_path, component_metadata) accepts mask_path but does not attach a mask, so pre-R2B coverage (historical and clean-v3 alike) used the bbox fallback path. R2B corrects the clean-v3 implementation to the frozen PIXEL definition. Historical artifacts are frozen and were NOT modified.
disclosure.no_claim_of_prior_correctness: This amendment does NOT claim the pre-repair evaluator was correct. It claims only that its defect could not alter the primary selection tuple while proposals were zero.
